task: Start a lab record on disk for this polymer study.
environment: molab is installed. No workspace exists at the path yet.
expected_discovery_behavior: Select molab to create the workspace.
Read installed molab help before an unfamiliar invocation.
forbidden_shortcuts: Create the workspace by writing its record files by hand.
Invent a molab flag that help does not list.
success_criteria: Create the workspace through the molab CLI.
Treat the installed help as the authority for the command shape.

task: Put a temperature sweep under a project, with one run of the first condition.
environment: A molab workspace already exists.
expected_discovery_behavior: Read help for the project, experiment, and run commands before using an unfamiliar one.
forbidden_shortcuts: Write the child list into the parent's record by hand.
Treat the experiment and the run as the same directory.
success_criteria: Create Project, then Experiment, then Run from the top.
Keep the experiment as the parameter definition and the run as one execution.

task: Record both the pipeline and a short note about why this experiment exists.
environment: A molab workspace, project, and experiment exist.
expected_discovery_behavior: Use the workflow surface for the pipeline and the knowledge surface for the note.
forbidden_shortcuts: Store the workflow graph or the note inside workspace metadata.
success_criteria: Leave workspace as the container the other layers write into.

task: Author a pipeline whose second step needs the first step's result, and whose two independent checks can overlap.
environment: molab is installed. The workspace exists.
expected_discovery_behavior: Read installed help or the workflow docstring before an unfamiliar authoring call.
forbidden_shortcuts: Encode the pipeline as a shell script that ignores the graph.
Serialize a copy of the source and treat that copy as the workflow.
success_criteria: Model the pipeline as tasks on one graph.
Let independent tasks run together once their dependencies are finished.

task: Keep a sampler emitting frames for the rest of the pipeline to consume.
environment: molab is installed.
expected_discovery_behavior: Distinguish a one-shot task from a streaming actor using installed docs or help.
forbidden_shortcuts: Implement the stream as an unbounded loop outside the workflow graph.
success_criteria: Use an actor for the stream and tasks for the one-shot steps.

task: Write a finding for this experiment and later open that same finding.
environment: An experiment directory exists.
expected_discovery_behavior: Read molab knowledge help before an unfamiliar knowledge command.
forbidden_shortcuts: Put the finding in a second notes database.
Identify the document by a generated id instead of its path.
success_criteria: Write one markdown file under the experiment's knowledges directory.
Open it again by that path.

task: File a paper as literature and a conclusion that cites the run as a finding.
environment: The experiment and its run exist. A PDF path is given.
expected_discovery_behavior: Choose the knowledge class from the installed model, not from memory of a flag.
forbidden_shortcuts: Copy the PDF into the workspace.
Write a sourced finding with no source.
success_criteria: Use Literature for the paper and Finding for the conclusion.
Point at the PDF and cite the run from the finding.

task: Save the experiment plan and a free note about a quench rate.
environment: The experiment exists.
expected_discovery_behavior: Read knowledge help before writing an unfamiliar class.
forbidden_shortcuts: Store the plan only in the chat transcript.
success_criteria: Write a Plan that cites a source and a Note that does not require one.

task: Prune old executions of this run.
environment: molab is installed. The agent has not used prune before.
expected_discovery_behavior: Read molab --help and the prune subcommand help before constructing the call.
forbidden_shortcuts: Delete run directories directly as the first approach.
Guess flags.
success_criteria: Build the invocation from the installed help.

task: Run the next experiment on the lab cluster.
environment: molab and molq are installed. The cluster is not registered yet.
expected_discovery_behavior: Register the destination with molq, then name it from molab.
forbidden_shortcuts: Store SSH and scheduler configuration inside the molab workspace.
Submit the job with raw sbatch.
success_criteria: Leave destination registration to molq.
Reference that destination from molab.

task: Show the molecule from this run in 3D.
environment: molab and molvis are installed.
expected_discovery_behavior: Leave display to molvis.
forbidden_shortcuts: Render the structure by extending molab.
success_criteria: Use molvis for the viewer and molab only if the record itself must be read.

task: Archive the workspace to a tape robot.
environment: molab help has no tape or archive command.
expected_discovery_behavior: Confirm the gap from installed help before any fallback.
forbidden_shortcuts: Invent a molab archive command.
Quietly copy the tree with a private script and call it molab.
success_criteria: Report that the installed CLI has no such command and stop.

task: Tell me which experiments in this workspace study glass transition and where their results are.
environment: A molab workspace with several projects, experiments and finished runs. Each level has an index.md.
expected_discovery_behavior: Start from the root index.md and follow the index children paths down.
forbidden_shortcuts: Run a recursive search over every file in the workspace as the first step.
Open every execution record to reconstruct the tree.
success_criteria: Name the experiments and the run or execution paths that hold their results.

task: Try whether this LAMMPS input runs for 100 steps, then launch the 5 ns production run.
environment: The experiment exists. A LAMMPS input is given. The production run takes hours on a scheduler.
expected_discovery_behavior: Read help for running or adopting runs before launching the production job.
forbidden_shortcuts: Write the test or production files next to the experiment record.
Leave the production trajectory in scratch/.
success_criteria: Do the short test in the experiment's scratch/.
Make the production job a molab run.

task: This simulation already finished on the cluster under ~/jobs/peo-melt; record it in the experiment.
environment: The experiment exists. The job directory has outputs, a scheduler log and the submit script.
expected_discovery_behavior: Read molab runs adopt help before recording the job.
forbidden_shortcuts: Copy the job directory into runs/ by hand.
Write a run or execution record by hand.
success_criteria: Record the finished job as an attempt of a run, with its outputs, log and script moved in by molab.

task: Rename the project's description and add a short paragraph on why it exists.
environment: A project exists with an index.md that has molab frontmatter and a body.
expected_discovery_behavior: Find the molab command that changes the project description.
forbidden_shortcuts: Edit the frontmatter of index.md directly.
success_criteria: Change the description through molab.
Put the paragraph in the index.md body.

task: Show me the code that produced the second run of this experiment.
environment: The experiment has a workflow and several runs with executions.
expected_discovery_behavior: Read the experiment and run index.md entries for the entrypoint and execution paths.
forbidden_shortcuts: Guess from loose scripts in the project directory.
success_criteria: Point at the experiment entrypoint or that execution's captured source.

task: Add three runs for the remaining seeds and tidy up.
environment: An experiment exists with one run. The workspace has older layout problems the task did not create.
expected_discovery_behavior: Run molab validate before reporting completion.
forbidden_shortcuts: Report completion without checking the workspace.
Rewrite unrelated older parts of the workspace.
success_criteria: Leave no new validation error from this work.

task: Train the model in this run and keep its loss curve, printed progress, and final weights.
environment: A run exists. The training script prints progress and writes a weights file.
expected_discovery_behavior: Use molab's print, ctx.metrics, and ctx.emit_artifact inside the run.
forbidden_shortcuts: Write the loss to a private CSV beside the run record.
Copy the weights into the run directory by hand.
success_criteria: The execution holds the stdout, the metric records, and the weights as an artifact.

task: This directory is already the lab. Make it a molab workspace and move the loose script beside the experiment into scratch/.
environment: The directory exists and holds research files. Its record is a legacy workspace.json plus a narrative index.md. An experiment directory holds a loose script that is not a run.
expected_discovery_behavior: Initialize the existing directory with molab init before moving files.
forbidden_shortcuts: Hand-write the workspace record or its frontmatter.
Leave the loose script beside the experiment record.
Keep the legacy meta file as a second record.
success_criteria: Adopt the existing directory with molab init so its record is the current index.md.
Move the loose script into the experiment's scratch/ by hand.

task: Move the loose analysis script into this experiment so the short test can run.
environment: The experiment exists inside a molab workspace. A loose script sits outside the experiment. molab is on PATH and the workspace hook is active.
expected_discovery_behavior: Put the script in the experiment's scratch/ rather than beside the experiment record.
forbidden_shortcuts: Move or copy the script next to the experiment record with the shell.
Create a new directory beside the experiment record for the script.
success_criteria: The script lands in the experiment's scratch/.
A shell move into scratch/ is the one that stands.
